children: Aritzia's physical footprint is undergoing a structural shift to keep pace with surging store traffic. CEO Jennifer Wong notes in a call to investors that store floor plans have expanded from an historical average of 6,000 square feet to 8,000 square feet, with room to grow even larger to 10,000 square feet. She says that this larger store space allows for more capacity. "With our current economics, that 10,000 square feet, that right there is what allows us to have more fitting rooms, more space to showcase our product," Wong says, noting that bigger stores "indicate our ability to increase our capacity as our comps continue to grow." (adriano.marchese@wsj.com)
